The {{Term/Store|Rubber Set||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref name="TotK Piggyback 404"/> also known as the {{Term/Store|Rubber Armor||BotW}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}<ref name="CaC 180"/> is a recurring [[Armor Set]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Location and Uses==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Descriptions BotW}}
The Rubber Armor is an [[Armor Set]] consisting of the [[Rubber Helm]], [[Rubber Armor]], and [[Rubber Tights]]. All three pieces are obtained in places connected to [[Thunderstorm]]s:
*The Helm is obtained as a reward from completing the "[[Thunder Magnet]]" [[Side Quest]] at [[Lakeside Stable]].
*The Armor is obtained from a Treasure Chest in [[Toh Yahsa Shrine]] at [[Thundra Plateau]], accessed by completing the "[[Trial of Thunder]]" [[Shrine Quest]].
*The Tights are obtained from a Treasure Chest in [[Qukah Nata Shrine]] at [[Calora Lake]], accessed by completing the "[[A Song of Storms]]" Shrine Quest.

Each piece of the Rubber Armor increases [[Link]]'s [[Shock Resistance]] by one level. If all three pieces are worn and have been [[Enhancing|Enhance]]d at least twice by a [[Great Fairy]], they provide the [[Unshockable|Lightning Proof]] [[Set Bonus]], preventing Link from being stunned from [[Electricity|Electrocution]].
